integrity: The proof is analytic; finite experiments are not used as evidence. The q=1 endpoint is proved separately and the q=2 boundary is only a consistency check.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for real sequence spaces, 1<=q<2, and does not classify all extremizers or assert anything new at q>=2.
title: Exact sub-Hilbert branch of the four-term von Neumann–Jordan constant on \(\ell_q\)
